SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.DOCNUM + Cast(S.DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) LINKROWID ,S.[DOCTYP] ,S.[DOCNUM] ,S.[DOCLIN] ,S.[FAC] ,F.FACNAM ,S.[ITMNO] ,ITM.ITMNAM --产品描述 ,ITM.ITMNAM1 ,ITM.ITMNAM2 ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,S.[ITMVER] ,S.[IVATTYP] ,IVATTYP.OPTDES IVATTYPDES ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.REQDAT, 23) [REQDAT] ,S.UOM UOM ,S.[UOMCOE] ,S.[STU] ,S.[QTY] ,S.[QTYSTU] ,S.CTRQTY ,S.CTRNUM ,S.[PRCQTY] ,S.[PRCQTYSTU] ,S.[PRTQTY] ,S.[PRTQTYSTU] ,POR.CUR PORCUR ,CASE WHEN POR.CUR = H.CUR THEN 1 ELSE R.CURRAT END CURRAT --,PDL.[NETPRI] PORNETPRI ,CASE WHEN POR.CUR = H.CUR THEN PDL.NETPRI WHEN R.RATETYPE = 'MUL' THEN Cast(PDL.NETPRI * R.CURRAT AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) WHEN R.RATETYPE = 'DIV' THEN Cast(PDL.NETPRI / R.CURRAT AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) END AS PORNETPRI ,S.[NETPRI] ,S.[GROPRI] ,S.[TAXRT] ,S.[NETAMT] ,S.[TAXAMT] ,S.[GRPAMT] ,S.[CHAREA] ,S.[REMARK] ,S.[LOT] ,S.[SRCTYP] ,S.[SRCDOC] ,S.[SRCLIN] ,S.[ORITYP] ,S.[ORIDOC] ,S.[ORILIN] ,S.[DOCSTA] ,S.[CLOREA] ,POR.CONTNOE --合同号 ,S.CVFCOD ,S.[CREUSR] ,S.[UPDUSR] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[CRETIM], 21) CRETIM ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[UPDTIM], 21) UPDTIM ,Iif(S.DOCSTA IN( '1', '5' ), '', '1') LDEBFLG ,Iif(S.DOCSTA IN( '1', '2' ), '', '1') LCLBFLG ,S.[SRCDOC] + '-' + Cast(S.[SRCLIN] AS VARCHAR) PORKEY ,S.DOCNUM + '-' + Cast(S.[DOCLIN] AS VARCHAR) AUDKEY FROM [PBOLD] S LEFT JOIN PBOLH H ON H.DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM INNER JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN ENTFAC F ON F.FAC = S.FAC LEFT JOIN LINKOPT IVATTYP ON IVATTYP.OPTID = S.IVATTYP AND IVATTYP.OPTTYP = 'IVATTYP' LEFT JOIN PORDER POR ON POR.DOCNUM = S.SRCDOC LEFT JOIN PORDLIN PDL ON PDL.DOCNUM = S.SRCDOC AND PDL.DOCLIN = S.SRCLIN OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 CURRAT ,CASE WHEN CUR = POR.CUR AND DESCUR = H.CUR THEN 'MUL' WHEN CUR = H.CUR AND DESCUR = POR.CUR THEN 'DIV' END AS RATETYPE FROM CURRAT WHERE RATDAT <= H.DOCDAT AND ( ( CUR = POR.CUR AND DESCUR = H.CUR ) OR ( CUR = H.CUR AND DESCUR = POR.CUR ) ) ORDER BY RATDAT DESC ,CRETIM DESC) R WHERE S.[DOCNUM] = '{0}' ORDER BY S.DOCLIN
SysDataModelXML.SQLNew: --LINKADDNEWROWS --LINKAUTOREPLACEEMPTYCOLUMNS DECLARE @NUM INT; SELECT @NUM=ISNULL(MAX(DOCLIN),0)+10 FROM [PBOLD] WHERE DOCNUM = N'#DOCNUM#' ; MERGE INTO [PBOLD] D USING ( SELECT N'#DOCNUM#' DOCNUM ,IIF(0#DOCLIN#=0,@NUM,0#DOCLIN#) DOCLIN ,N'#FAC#' FAC ,N'#ITMNO#' ITMNO ,N'#ITMVER#' ITMVER ,N'#IVATTYP#' IVATTYP ,N'#REQDAT#' REQDAT ,N'#UOM#' UOM ,0#UOMCOE# UOMCOE ,N'#STU#' STU ,0#QTY# QTY ,0#NETPRI# NETPRI ,0#GROPRI# GROPRI ,0#TAXRT# TAXRT ,0#NETPRI#*0#QTYSTU# NETAMT --无税金额 ,0#TAXAMT# TAXAMT ,0#GROPRI#*0#QTYSTU# GRPAMT --含税金额 ,N'#CHAREA#' CHAREA ,N'#REMARK#' REMARK ,N'#SRCTYP#' SRCTYP ,N'#SRCDOC#' SRCDOC ,0#SRCLIN# SRCLIN ,N'#ORITYP#' ORITYP ,N'#ORIDOC#' ORIDOC ,0#ORILIN# ORILIN ,N'#CLOREA#' CLOREA ,N'1' DOCSTA ,N'#LOGIN_USER#' CREUSR , GETDATE() CRETIM ) S ON (S.[DOCNUM] = D.[DOCNUM] AND S.DOCLIN=D.DOCLIN) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET FAC = S.FAC ,ITMNO = S.ITMNO ,ITMVER = S.ITMVER ,IVATTYP = S.IVATTYP ,REQDAT = S.REQDAT ,UOM = S.UOM ,UOMCOE = S.UOMCOE ,STU = S.STU ,QTY = S.QTY ,NETPRI = S.NETPRI ,GROPRI = S.GROPRI ,TAXRT = S.TAXRT ,NETAMT = S.NETAMT ,TAXAMT = S.TAXAMT ,GRPAMT = S.GRPAMT ,CHAREA = S.CHAREA ,REMARK = S.REMARK ,SRCTYP = S.SRCTYP ,SRCDOC = S.SRCDOC ,SRCLIN = S.SRCLIN ,ORITYP = S.ORITYP ,ORIDOC = S.ORIDOC ,ORILIN = S.ORILIN ,CLOREA = S.CLOREA ,[UPDUSR]='#LOGIN_USER#' ,[UPDTIM]=GETDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DOCNUM ,DOCLIN ,FAC ,ITMNO ,ITMVER ,IVATTYP ,REQDAT ,UOM ,UOMCOE ,STU ,QTY ,NETPRI ,GROPRI ,TAXRT ,NETAMT ,TAXAMT ,GRPAMT ,CHAREA ,REMARK ,SRCTYP ,SRCDOC ,SRCLIN ,ORITYP ,ORIDOC ,ORILIN ,DOCSTA ,CLOREA ,CREUSR ,CRETIM ) VALUES ( S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCLIN ,S.FAC ,S.ITMNO ,S.ITMVER ,S.IVATTYP ,S.REQDAT ,S.UOM ,S.UOMCOE ,S.STU ,S.QTY ,S.NETPRI ,S.GROPRI ,S.TAXRT ,S.NETAMT ,S.TAXAMT ,S.GRPAMT ,S.CHAREA ,S.REMARK ,S.SRCTYP ,S.SRCDOC ,S.SRCLIN ,S.ORITYP ,S.ORIDOC ,S.ORILIN ,S.DOCSTA ,S.CLOREA ,S.CREUSR ,S.CRETIM );
